note: The target guide says, “They do not identify why it sits where it does, and BLS publishes no causal figure for the gap,” which supports the bridge’s caveat about what the wage gap does and does not measure.
sentence: A field at the far end of the same question is software development, where the BLS median of $135,980 runs about 2.6 times the sales agent figure; this site\'s guide to [why software engineers make so much](/why-do-software-engineers-make-so-much/) sets out what that gap does and does not measure.
